asciichat_error_t openpgp_extract_ed25519_from_mpi (const uint8_t * mpi, size_t mpi_len, uint8_t ed25519_pk[ED25519_PUBLIC_KEY_SIZE])

Definition at line 172 of file openpgp.c.

173                                                                                                 {
174   if (!mpi || !ed25519_pk || mpi_len < 35) {
175     return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_INVALID_PARAM, "Invalid parameters for MPI extraction (need at least 35 bytes)");
176   }
177
178   // MPI format:
179   // - 2 bytes: bit count (big-endian)
180   // - 1 byte: 0x40 prefix (Ed25519 marker)
181   // - 32 bytes: Ed25519 public key
182
183   uint16_t bit_count = ((uint16_t)mpi[0] << 8) | mpi[1];
184   log_debug("MPI bit count: %u", bit_count);
185
186   // Ed25519 with 0x40 prefix is typically 263 bits (0x0107)
187   if (bit_count < 256 || bit_count > 270) {
188     return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO_KEY, "Unexpected MPI bit count for Ed25519: %u (expected ~263)", bit_count);
189   }
190
191   // Check for 0x40 prefix byte
192   if (mpi[2] != 0x40) {
193     return SET_ERRNO(ERROR_CRYPTO_KEY, "Missing 0x40 prefix byte in Ed25519 MPI (found 0x%02x)", mpi[2]);
194   }
195
196   // Extract 32-byte Ed25519 public key
197   memcpy(ed25519_pk, mpi + 3, ED25519_PUBLIC_KEY_SIZE);
198
199   return ASCIICHAT_OK;
200 }
